evidence: Changes error handling in src/index/txindex.cpp to throw on I/O and index corruption errors.
rationale: TxIndex now properly surfaces read errors and corruption instead of silently returning empty results. As commit fa5c96a112 notes, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception' rather than falsely returning that a transaction does not exist.
